title: Build one word list per errand
summary: Group vocabulary by the task you will need it for, such as a pharmacy run or a metro trip.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

blocks.body: Random lists of interesting words are hard to use and easy to drop. A list built around one errand is self-explanatory: for a pharmacy trip you need the words for fever, medicine, how many times a day, and side effects; for the metro you need exit, change trains, tap your card, and the last service of the day. Keep each list to ten items or fewer and write a one-line sentence for anything you expect to say out loud. Before a real errand, reread that list on the way and review it again that evening, while the situation is still fresh in your memory.

blocks.title: A pharmacy run in six words
body: 发烧 fāshāo — to have a fever
一天几次？ yì tiān jǐ cì? — How many times a day?
你有没有这个药？ nǐ yǒu méi yǒu zhège yào? — Do you have this medicine?
